{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter for customers who converted (converted == 1)
converted_customers = sales[sales['converted'] == 1]

# Exclude rows where customer_age == -1 (sentinel for missing data)
valid_converted_customers = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute the mean age
mean_age = valid_converted_customers['customer_age'].mean()

# Print the required numbers
print(f"Number of converted customers: {len(converted_customers)}")
print(f"Number of converted customers with valid age: {len(valid_converted_customers)}")
print(f"Mean age of converted customers with valid age: {mean_age}")"}
